{{Quote|One time on Cyborrea, we had to drop from sixteen miles up! No air, full space gear&hellip;|A [[Rocket-Jumper Elite Advance Unit|Republic rocket-jumper]]|<ref name="TotJ">[[Tales of the Jedi (audio drama)|''Tales of the Jedi'' audio drama]]</ref>}}
An '''environment suit''', '''enviro-suit''', '''pressure suit''', '''g-suit''', '''space suit''', '''vac suit''', '''vacc suit''', or '''EVA suit''' was a sealed, self-contained suit (including helmet) worn by a [[Humanoid/Legends|humanoid]] to survive in hostile environments, such as [[Poison/Legends|poisonous]] gas, deep [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]] [[Water/Legends|water]], or [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]]. They provided breathing substance&mdash;such as [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]]&mdash;and maintained necessary pressure inside the suit. They were normally used in Type IV [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]], but with some exceptions. They also had an EVA durability of eight hours, and likewise were classified under [[Class D spacesuit]]s.

==Technology==
There were many types of enviro-suits in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], as indicated by the variety of names which this type of outfit was called. Their common feature was that they offered protection for the wearer from lethal or nearly-lethal effects of the environment.
[[File:AhsokaEnvirosuit-SWE.jpg|thumb|left|200px|[[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]] in an Enviro-suit]]
The majority of the [[Species/Legends|species]] in the galaxy could not survive in every environment, due to one or more factors:
*Most species' bodies contained internal voids such as veins, [[Lung/Legends|lungs]], or swim bladders, which held various fluids. An individual exposed to sufficiently low pressure could suffer severe damage from the expansion of these fluids, even to the point of organ rupture. In most [[Near-Human]] species, [[Blood/Legends|blood]] pressure was insufficient to rupture major blood vessels even in total [[Vacuum/Legends|vacuum]], so the greatest risk was to the delicate gas-exchange sacs in the lungs. However, species which evolved in high-pressure environments, such as [[Skakoan/Legends|Skakoans]], could literally burst in the vacuum of space.
*Low pressure could also cause complications due to the effervescence of gases dissolved in internal liquids and tissues.
*Most species required a constant supply of some breathing fluid, often gaseous [[Oxygen/Legends|oxygen]] or oxygenated [[Water/Legends|water]]. Without this, they would suffocate within minutes or seconds.
*Most species required protection against [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmospheres]] that were toxic to their biology.
*Most species required protection from extremely low or high temperatures, cosmic radiation, bright light (especially UV-light of stars in space), and other miscellaneous hazards, 

Common characteristics of enviro-suits were that they sealed the user's body from the environment hermetically. For most species, however, if they wanted to work or just survive for a longer period in the hostile environment, they had to carry at least an amount of their own atmosphere with them for breathing and for maintaining the pressure around their body. The supply for this atmosphere was usually in a high-pressure tank mounted on the back of the suit, which carried an amount of the user's atmosphere which was usually enough for a few standard hours of average activity. Most environmental suits usually provided their users with some degree of protection from heat, too.

Enviro-suits were often used in [[Realspace/Legends|space]]. To allow mobility for the user in zero [[Gravity/Legends|gravity]], they were usually fitted with [[rocket pack]]s.

Although some enviro-suits allowed underwater exploration, not all did.<ref name="It's a Trap">"[[It's a Trap]]"</ref>

==Usage==
[[File:Zayne_jarael_space_suits.jpg|thumb|180px|[[Jarael]] and [[Zayne Carrick]] in space suits.]]
Typically, enviro-suits were used by individuals to enter space, often for the purpose of doing repairs on the surface or in the depressurized compartments of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] or [[Space station/Legends|space stations]], usually if there were no [[Droid/Legends|droids]] available for this task. The typical enviro-suit for this purpose was often called a ''space suit''.

The usage of enviro-suit covered even military activities: in the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], the Republic's [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] were able to assault enemy starships directly through space, when they were equipped with a specialized armor with rocket packs, which was of course also an enviro-suit. A famous example was when, under the command of [[Jedi General/Legends|General]] [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]], the troopers of the seriously damaged [[Venator-class Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]], the ''[[Impavid/Legends|Impavid]]'', captured the ''[[Prosperous/Legends|Prosperous]]'', a [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederate]] [[Providence-class carrier/destroyer/Legends|''Providence''-class destroyer]] in the [[Battle of Coruscant/Legends|Battle of Coruscant]].

Later under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire]], the [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] had a special division called [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|space troopers]], whose special armor was in fact a reinforced environmental suit with a rocket pack on the back. These type of stormtroopers were deployed sometimes in [[Space warfare/Legends|space battles]], where their task was to sabotage enemy starships after landing on their surface. At the same time, the [[Alliance Special Forces/Legends|Rebel Special Forces]] SpaceOps used a [[Rebel SpecForce Armor|lighter variant]] of enviro-suit. This was equipped with a jetpack that used short a burst to propel the Marine through space.

Although not specifically intended as an enviro-suit, [[Darth Vader's armor]] was sealed against harsh environmental conditions, including the vacuum of space.

Another area of frequent usage was the activity of dry-land species under water, members of which would otherwise suffocate or be crushed by the high pressure of kilometer-thick water layers. This type of enviro-suit was sometimes called ''pressure suit''. Regular spacesuits, however, could not function underwater due to pressure differences, as evidenced by Han Solo's attempted usage of a spacesuit to retrieve the ''Millennium Falcon'' from [[lake worm]]s on the planet [[Daluuj/Legends|Daluuj]] and becoming overwhelmed in little time.<ref name="It's a Trap" />

Some species had to wear a pressure suit on almost any planet other than their homeworld. Famous examples were the Skakoans, who could only travel to other planets wearing a [[Pressure suit/Legends|special protective suit]] since they would suffer severe decompression in typical Type I atmospheres.

==Notable uses==
[[Revan/Legends|Revan]] wore an enviro-suit to survive the high pressure at the bottom of the [[Hrakert Rift]] on [[Manaan/Legends|Manaan]] in [[3956 BBY]]. Later that year, Revan, [[Carth Onasi]], and [[Bastila Shan]] also donned environmental suits in order to access the bridge of the [[Leviathan (Interdictor-class cruiser)|Leviathan]], which had been sealed off.

The miners at the [[Peragus Mining Facility]] wore such suits when working in vacuum, as did [[Meetra Surik]] when she visited the facility in [[3951 BBY]]. [[Mira]] later stole the suit from Surik and used it to gain entry into the [[Jekk'Jekk Tarr]], a non-human oriented [[cantina]]. The cantina circulated [[Cyanogen]] gas, which was deadly to humans but several other species could breathe it easily. 

[[File:Kenobi_space_walk.png|thumb|right|250px|Obi-Wan Kenobi space walks in an enviro-suit towards Count Dooku's frigate.]]
[[Darth Tenebrous/Legends|Darth Tenebrous]] and his apprentice, [[Darth Plagueis/Legends|Darth Plagueis]], wore enviro-suits on the planet [[Bal'demnic/Legends|Bal'demnic]].

During the Clone Wars, [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] wore a space suit to sneak aboard [[Count Dooku's frigate/Legends|Count Dooku's frigate]] to "rescue" [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]. Skywalker had allowed himself to be taken captive in a planned operation to capture the leader of the Confederacy of Independent Systems.

[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] and [[Lobot/Legends|Lobot]] wore spacesuits to explore the interior of the [[Teljkon Vagabond]] when it had been located in [[17 ABY/Legends|17 ABY.]]

On their mission to infiltrate [[Centerpoint Station]] in [[40 ABY/Legends|40 ABY]], [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and his apprentice [[Ben Skywalker]] donned environmental suits in order to move on the airless surface of the station.
